images.alt: Blue tile with white text in the centre which reads, "Health and Independence Report 2024. Now published." At the bottom are the logos for Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa (New Zealand Government) and Ministry of Health (Manatū Hauora).

post.text:
The 2024 Health and Independence Report has been published. This report provides a comprehensive overview of public health and system performance in Aotearoa New Zealand for 2024.

Read more on our website: www.health.govt.nz/publications...
